topic: Google your own business: the 3 things to check

script.hook: Google your business. You might be shocked.
beats: Check your business name, address, and phone number are exactly correct everywhere.
Look at your reviews. One unanswered bad review kills trust fast.
See what photo shows first. A blurry pic sends customers somewhere else.
